scope: observed development scene, post-shot source actuator-stance capture; request no root/ball state or change to real ball cue
registration: one full 14 s CPU run per fixed candidate, stop candidate on nonfinite. Preserve failed and passed episodes; if both pass prefer first closed-loop only after reporting ablation.
source: Pratt et al., Capture Point: A Step toward Humanoid Push Recovery, doi:10.1109/ICHR.2006.321385; local tools/support_balance.py (standing CoP feedback).
evidence: Capture only after final reference frame and sustained bilateral stance; old target with original reference and true physical ball until then. 50 Hz captured terminal posture and optional COM+velocity ankle feedback in original implicit drives.
acceptance: Preserve legal pre-handoff prefix and goal/unchanged strike; original CPU safety full14s, nonfoot <=20N, q/qdot within original tolerances, end bilateral support/standing under existing metrics; no biological/Isaac USD generalization claim.
